reason: A is the better, though still weak, proposal because it isolates a plausible defect-density–adsorbate-coverage–durability relationship with a direct operando test and baseline. B is undermined by conflating tensile strain with Pt isolation, asserting the questionable direction of the strain–d-band effect, and using synthesis changes that simultaneously alter composition and ordering; it also lacks direct product analysis needed to test the claimed 12-electron selectivity.
